notes.title: Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35724847/db80f39efa209caf23a66be7cf7c6cda4280a7a4.gif[/img]

Hello,

The day has come, AMazing TD is now fully released on Steam.
[h3]
[b]Thank you[/b][/h3]
    We thank all who played with us this game since 2010. It took a long journey since just being a mod called Split TD in Starcraft 2 Beta.
    We are grateful to all who helped us in early access to test, optimize and find bugs in the game.
    We value almost all of the feedback and a lot of game improvements came out in the last 1 and a half years.
    We would like to thank all of you who bought the game and allowed all of this to happen.

[h3][b]The journey ahead[/b][/h3]
    The development of this fun project won't stop. Next, we want to focus on a map editor, which will allow us to further expand the challenge mode and add similar game modes. But don't worry, randomized maps will stay and one day they might be generated by machine-learning algorithms.

Feel free to join the official Discord to celebrate or discuss the road map or anything else you wish: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/HRDkRc5]https://discordapp.com/invite/7yYTKgU[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35724847/dd8624005cbb726a4ed3ef445c10b0932742a261.gif[/img]
